head: 108ea8e8fca4b9fe2bd5ed706b24f4dc80bea31d
why: Recheck of today's CI tooling after the fix round for review 2's one fault. The new it.effect.prop TT8 law catches the status-gate narrowing that got past the old examples. Its oracle comes from the draw alone, independent of readQueueWait and timestamp. Its coverage tally fails when a required case is never drawn. Product code is unchanged. Three non-blocking finding rows: valid times only span 2026-09 to 2027-01 so a leap-day calendar plant gets through, the law passes its own seed against 0579, and the vector label holds made-up cases.
note: Head existed only on this machine at the recheck (a sev0 held pushes). Cloud box, Node 26.13.0, nice 15, one worker. time-table.test.ts 11 passed; scoped lint 0 blocking. Plants run once each on the real files and restored by sha256: status gate pending-only red; equal order rejected red; offsets rejected red; skipped check dropped red; tally given a case never drawn red; every Feb 29 rejected green. The tally records that bad kinds were drawn, not that they decided the answer, so reach for calendar, zone and runner plants rests on the fixed seed 119120. git status clean at end. Requested model opus, effort high.
